name: EchoNet
description: This outline as a node on a FidoNet-style network of outlines: named views and tagged notes as areas, subscriptions by node mask that copy them in (copies that drift, never a sync), netmail both ways on marks, seen-by marks, a nodelist and a toss log.

offline.description: Nodes (name@machine) to treat as unreachable this toss: a lid shut on purpose

keepLogs.description: How many toss logs stay under the nodelist (default 20)

cap.description: New messages copied per source each toss when a subscription has no [cap::n] (default 25)

undeliverableAfter.description: Tosses netmail waits for an original that is gone before it becomes an undeliverable note (default 3)

actions.label: Toss mail
actions.description: Copies new messages from every subscribed area, marks copies whose original is newer or gone, carries netmail both ways, writes the nodelist and a toss log

actions.label: Write the nodelist
actions.description: Writes the nodelist again without tossing: each known node, reachable or not, its access, areas and subscriptions

actions.label: Take the newer version
actions.description: On an EchoNet copy: replaces its text with the original's current one (its own edits go; its history keeps them)

actions.label: Compare with the newer version
actions.description: On an EchoNet copy: proposes the original's current text beside it, the difference shown, to apply or dismiss
